result.title: DisSparse: Pipelined Top-$p$ Sparse Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving
result.summary: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by the memory demands of the key-value (KV) cache, whose size scales linearly with context length. Dynamic sparse attention reduces this bottleneck by fetching and attending only to a critical subset of tokens. The dominant primitive in dynamic sparse attention research and deployment is fixed-budget top-$k$ selection, which is favored because its deterministic block count aligns with the static memory allocation that systems like vLLM rely on. Top-$k$ uses a fixed budget regardless of how attention mass is distributed across heads, layers, and decode steps, leading to either wasted bandwidth on heads with peaky attention or dropped context on heads with diffuse attention. Top-$p$ (nucleus) selection adapts naturally to this variation but has seen limited adoption in production serving systems due to two system-level challenges: variable block counts that break deterministic block allocation and computationally expensive selection kernels that exceed the cost of attention itself. We present DisSparse, a serving system that integrates top-$p$ sparse attention into vLLM end-to-end. DisSparse decouples block selection from the scheduler's critical path, hides selection latency behind layer computation via a two-stream pipeline, and introduces a single-pass histogram-based top-$p$ kernel. We further observe intra-block sparsity, the inflation of selection budgets caused by mixing high- and low-importance tokens within fixed-size KV cache blocks, and address it with a token relocation kernel guided by accumulated prefill attention scores. Across long- and medium-context benchmarks on multiple models, DisSparse achieves 1.17x to 1.80x speedup in sparsity analysis (block selection) over state-of-the-art top-$p$ methods with negligible accuracy loss and supports up to 8x larger maximum batch sizes than dense vLLM under the same memory budget.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作将 top-p（nucleus）稀疏注意力端到端集成进 vLLM 服务系统：把块选择移出调度器关键路径、用双流流水线隐藏选择延迟，并以单遍直方图核实现 top-p 选择，同时针对块内重要性混杂提出按 prefill 注意力分数引导的 token 重排核。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用注意力质量分布自适应决定保留预算（相对固定 top-k）、并据注意力分数重排 token 的做法，或可为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与自适应保留/计算预算提供可核查的思路线索，但论文本身面向 KV cache 服务吞吐，未涉及推理状态或视觉。
